ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the photograph there is an isolated tree; the crown is wider and denser on the left side of the picture, and relatively less on the right side; on the ground, the tree shadow extends obliquely from near the trunk toward the lower right of the picture. Then reason: the question stem states that plants have phototropism, and the side with better light conditions grows better. Northwest China is located in the Northern Hemisphere, and the side of trees that receives more sunlight is generally the south side, so the side where the tree crown grows better in the figure can be judged to be the south side. After thus fixing the directions in the picture, the tree shadow in the figure extending obliquely toward the lower right of the picture corresponds to the actual direction of northeast. The direction of the shadow is opposite to the direction of the sun, so the sun is located in the southwest direction. In local time, the sun being in the southwest usually occurs in the afternoon, close to 16:00. Therefore, the local time at the time of shooting may have been 16:00.
